requests: requests: the package the request functions are imported from
request: requests: requests.request, which takes the method as its first argument
method: requests: the keyword requests.request takes the method under
url: requests: the keyword every request function takes the URL under
Session: requests: the constructor for a session, whose instances take the same calls
clientCall: suss: PyClientCall variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
status_code: requests: Response.status_code, the status the server sent
ok: requests: Response.ok, true for a status under 400
json: requests: Response.json, the body parsed as JSON
text: requests: Response.text, the body as a string
content: requests: Response.content, the body as bytes
